name: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd
title: VST Tillers Tractors Ltd-$ - 531266 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: No formal FY27 guidance; industry volume seen at 10–11 lakh, broadly flat unless state schemes arrive, with ~1.5% price pass-through and monsoon the swing factor.

triggers.label: Price pass-through ~1.5% YTD
triggers.quote: overall we have been able to pass on roughly about one and a half% increase

triggers.label: Industry volume seen flat at 10–11 lakh
triggers.quote: I believe the industry volume is likely to remain around the 10–11 lakh range

triggers.label: Above-50 HP volumes down post TREM V
triggers.quote: we have seen volumes decline in the above -50 HP segment after the introduction of the new emission norms

red_flags.label: No formal FY27 guidance
red_flags.quote: we are not providing any formal guidance at this stage

red_flags.label: Management says volume may turn negative
red_flags.quote: or turn slightly negative. I would not want to venture into any prediction at this stage
